svg.desc: Action Priority overview: System FMEA SFM rev 0.37 H 107, M 1, L 1; DFMEA DFM rev 0.13 H 32, M 0, L 0; SW FMEA SWF rev 1.12 H 132, M 1, L 16; PFMEA PFM rev 0.4 H 17, M 0, L 1.
